manifest.queue_order: Stable sorted node IDs within each active round; neighbors enter the next round; node-local gradient steps read the current workspace
manifest.budget_scope: All added-edge frame initialization/traversal reads, incident-edge reads and full convergence certificates; input/load/preprocessing and coordinate translations are separately counted and timed
manifest.fallback: disabled; exhausted updates leave saved state unchanged
manifest.initialization: Exact shared saved C0 geometry compiled from public offsets, certified and saved before every intervention; all setup/load costs charged
manifest.update_initialization: Every old component is a rigid frame and each added node a singleton frame. A stable spanning tree of added inter-frame constraints initializes frame translations, preserving old internal answers. Cycles and contradictions still use the declared residual relaxation. All frame edge reads share the dynamic cap; global translations are timed and counted. No reference/truth access.
manifest.controls: Third disconnected component is unaffected; distant connected nodes are potentially affected, never required to remain fixed
manifest.reference: Independent sparse anchored least squares (preconditioned conjugate gradients), qualified against independent dense LS at small sizes; compiled coordinates also measured
manifest.acceptance: Every result is reference-correct when committed or explicitly unresolved with byte-identical previous state; all budget, reference, retention and reload checks pass
manifest.claim_scope: 16 registered structured interventions, one world per size; no uncertainty/generalization or sublinear end-to-end claim
manifest.selection_rule: No tuning or adaptive selection; all cases and all unresolved outcomes are retained

hypothesis_limits: This panel tests additive state persistence and disconnected retention, without an adaptive-versus-frozen task-learning comparison. H-L has no sublinear end-to-end claim: preprocessing and global certificates scan full input. Only one structured world per size/intervention.
